Definition
[second covariant derivative]

Source: petersen:page-0079 ↗ def:pet-ch2-covariant-derivative-tensor

For an $(s,t)$-tensor field $S$, the second covariant derivative $ abla ^2S$ is the $(s,t+2)$-tensor field \[ ( abla ^2_{X_1,X_2}S)(Y_1,\dots ,Y_t) = ( abla _{X_1}( abla S))(X_2,Y_1,\dots ,Y_t) = ( abla _{X_1}( abla _{X_2}S))(Y_1,\dots ,Y_t)-( abla _{ abla _{X_1}X_2}S)(Y_1,\dots ,Y_t). \]
